Budskapet behöver anpassas efter mottaga.en: The message must be adapted to the recipient

texto: Analyze irony, privacy and adaptation of messages to different audiences. **Budskapet behöver anpassas efter mottagaren** means «The message must be adapted to the recipient». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
